subject: Discovery follow-up: evaluation kickoff & trial scope
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophia Turner <sophia.turner@clearwavehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <t.alvarez@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: evaluation kickoff & trial scope

Hi Sophia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before we lock the kickoff: 
- Primary goal: validate a 40% inference cost reduction while maintaining clinical QA for note summarization and billing classification.
- Success criteria (proposed): 1) >95% accuracy on the annotated prompt set; 2) end-to-end median latency <250ms for 512-token requests in dedicated mode; 3) reproducible evals on your redacted dataset.
- Constraints: PHI needs one-way redaction during trial; key management will likely need to integrate with your KMS.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute evaluation kickoff that covers the trial plan, prompt pack, success criteria, and tech deep dive. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 2026-06-17 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-06-18 15:00–16:30
- Mon 2026-06-22 11:00–12:30

I’ve attached a short trial-charter template and our security questionnaire to help speed procurement and technical prep. If those look good, Ben can run the tech deep dive portion.

Can you confirm which slot works (or share other availability)? Also, could you attach an example prompt or small redacted sample we should include in the eval prompt set?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: evaluation kickoff & trial scope

Mina —

Appreciate the clear summary. We’re keen to proceed. Quick answers:
- Slot preference: June 17 in the afternoon looks promising; I need to confirm internally but 1pm PT is likely OK.
- Prompt sample: I can share a couple of anonymized clinical notes and the typical summarization prompts we use.
- Security: PHI handling is a must — we need to understand your default redaction options and whether we can route keys through our HSM/KMS. Can you include SOC 2 scope and any relevant audit evidence?

Tom will join for the initial kickoff; he’ll own compliance questions. If you can secure a calendar hold tentatively for June 17 13:00 PT, we’ll confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sophia Turner
Director of Product Operations | ClearWave Health
sophia.turner@clearwavehealth.com
(212) 555-4490

Hi Sophia / Mina —

I can take the technical deep dive during the kickoff. Two concrete slots that work on my side:
- Wed 2026-06-17 13:00–14:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu 2026-06-18 15:00–16:00 PT

Agenda I suggest for the 60–90 minute session:
1) Trial charter & success criteria (10–15m)
2) Architecture walkthrough: how we’ll deploy the trial (VPC/dedicated vs hosted fallback) (15–20m)
3) Data handling: redaction, encryption-in-flight/at-rest, KMS/HSM options (20m)
4) Prompt set & eval harness: how we’ll run reproducible checks and measure regressions (15–20m)
5) Q&A + next steps (10m)

I’ve attached the trial-charter-template.docx and security-questionnaire.pdf to this thread and dropped a copy in the linked Drive folder. For PHI we typically recommend two-step redaction + token-level access controls; happy to walk through a redaction demo if helpful.

Pre-reqs for the kickoff:
- Sophia: a representative redacted sample and 6–8 evaluation prompts (can be email attachments or Drive link)
- Legal/procurement: contact for the security questionnaire if you want us to route to the right reviewer

If June 17 13:00 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short runbook.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

Attachments: trial-charter-template.docx (docx, 45KB); security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 180KB)
